subject: Dispatch via in-session subagents (cloud and Mac alike): `auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker|verifier` sets up the round and prints a four-item pointer prompt; SESSION-START main section documents prepare -> subagent -> apply -> gate -> land; routine kept as a documented fallback only
feature: Dispatch: in-session subagent worker / verifier (D-061); routine as fallback
objective:
Rewrite of #149 per D-061 (2026-10-21). User's words: 「照你建議 worker 以後可能是雲端可能是地端 現在的方式較好的話 地端也可以這樣做」. The previous version of this ticket (auto-fix --cloud-prompt, apply --cloud-wait polling every 20 min, apply --cloud receiving `t<n>-cloud` branches, `cloud:` cost rows) is VOID: the routine path is no longer primary, so none of those three script entries is built.

What actually worked (#151, 2026-10-21, cloud container, uid 0; opener + worker were same-container subagents; apply/gate/land passed first try): main ran `git worktree add -b t<n> <worktree_dir>/t<n> <main>`, `ticket.py set` branch/base_sha, made an ad-hoc round dir `reports/t151/r1/`; the subagent prompt carried only four items (ticket, base sha, worktree, EVIDENCE path + report target); the subagent committed in the worktree, wrote EVIDENCE outside it and reported back; main ran `apply.sh 151 --evidence ...` -> `gate.sh --branch --ticket 151` -> `land.sh t151`. Drift observed in that manual run (read from tickets/151.json and reports/t151/): attempt stayed 0, EVIDENCE sat outside the convention `apply.sh` reads by default (`<worktree_dir>/fix-t<n>/round<r>/EVIDENCE-round<r>.md`, scripts/apply.sh:583) so `--evidence` had to be typed, and no rules pack / ticket snapshot file existed for the subagent. Every one of those steps already exists in auto-fix.sh's first-round path (round_once 1 when the ticket is Ready and has no status file): #57 base_sha bump, `ticket_worktree`, round dir, `first_round_packet`, verifier copy + `verifier_packet`, Ready->Running. The only part that does not fit in-session is the last step: starting a headless worker process.

Decision (opener): script ONE entry, reusing auto-fix's first-round code; everything else is documentation (D-016/D-018: one command per dispatch instead of ~6 hand-typed ones each re-sending main's context; estimated saving ~5 main tool round-trips per ticket, inferred, not measured).

(1) `sh scripts/auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker` = exactly what `sh scripts/auto-fix.sh <n>` does for a Ready ticket with no status file, stopped right before the worker process would start. Same preconditions (Ready and no status file; otherwise rc 2 naming why, nothing changed). Effects: base_sha bumped to main head under the existing #57 rule; worktree `<worktree_dir>/t<n>` on branch t<n> via `ticket_worktree`; round dir `<worktree_dir>/fix-t<n>/round1` created; `reports/t<n>/<run_id>/dispatch-round1.md` written by `first_round_packet` (rules pack + ticket snapshot + four items, same function as `--dry-run --round 1`); ticket Ready->Running. It does NOT: start any agent process, emit `ticket.attempt.start` or any agent.* event (nobody would emit the matching done/failed in-session and heartbeat.sh pairs them by attempt, scripts/heartbeat.sh:57), write a cost row, or write status.json. Model: the routed worker candidate (`route_worker`, honours the ticket's model/tool) when its tool is claude-code; otherwise the first claude-code candidate of that role's chain (worker reads role-models.py/route to pick the cleanest way); no claude-code candidate -> rc 2, nothing changed. The chosen model's card is the one in the packet. stdout ends with a short pointer prompt meant to be pasted verbatim into the Agent tool, and nothing else from the packet: a line `model=<m>`, then the role line, the absolute path of dispatch-round1.md ("read this first: rules pack + ticket snapshot + your four items"), ticket `#<n>` and ticket file path, full base sha, worktree absolute path (with a note that every command must run inside it, e.g. `cd <wt> && ...` / `git -C <wt>`, because subagent cwd resets per call), EVIDENCE absolute path `<worktree_dir>/fix-t<n>/round1/EVIDENCE-round1.md`, and "report back to the main session that dispatched you when done". The packet itself is NOT printed to stdout (main's context stays small; the subagent reads it once).
(2) `sh scripts/auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare verifier`: only when `verifier_wanted` says a verifier is wanted (needs_verifier not false and verify baseline empty; otherwise rc 2, nothing created). Copy source: ticket branch head when it has at least one commit beyond base_sha; else, when interface_fixed is JSON true, base_sha (parallel with the worker); else rc 2 with stderr saying to wait for the worker's hand-in, nothing created. Builds `<worktree_dir>/verify-t<n>/round1/{base,work}` with the existing git-archive copy code and writes `dispatch-verifier-round1.md` via `verifier_packet`. Does not touch the ticket file. stdout: same pointer-prompt shape (model=, dispatch path, ticket, source sha, copy root, `<copy>/patch-verify.diff` and `<copy>/EVIDENCE-verifier.md`, report target).
(3) `--prepare` cannot be combined with `--dry-run`, `--round`, `--batch` (rc 2). Usage line (auto-fix.sh:95), unknown-flag message (:132) and the file header list it. No new script file, no new ticket field, no new event kind, no new gate/land check. apply.sh, gate.sh, land.sh, review.sh are not changed: after a prepared round `sh scripts/apply.sh <n>` works with no `--evidence` (default path above) and sets the ticket `branch` itself (apply.sh:621-632).
(4) Docs only (no code):
  - docs/SESSION-START.md main section: one short paragraph "Dispatch (D-061; cloud and Mac alike)": `auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker` -> paste its pointer prompt into an in-session subagent with the printed model -> wait for its report (no polling) -> `apply.sh <n>` -> if a verifier is wanted: `--prepare verifier` (parallel when interface_fixed is true, otherwise after the worker's commit) -> subagent -> `apply.sh <n> <copy>/patch-verify.diff --evidence-verifier <copy>/EVIDENCE-verifier.md` -> `gate.sh --branch --ticket <n> --no-auto-fix` (green moves the ticket to InReview and calls review.sh itself for complex tickets) -> `land.sh t<n> --no-auto-fix`. Any refusal or red (apply rc 5 hard_block, gate red, land refusal): call the SAME subagent back with the refusal line; do not prepare again. `--no-auto-fix` because the default would start a headless worker round instead. One line pointing to the routine fallback in the reference.
  - docs/reference/role-procedures.md `## 主線操作細節`: `### Fallback: routine (cloud)` condensed from docs/HANDOFF.md "雲端 worker 的做法" (routine `ac-worker`: update the prompt, wait for update to return, then run; prompt = `auto-fix.sh <n> --dry-run --round 1` packet plus a delivery paragraph: `git fetch origin` first, branch `t<n>-cloud` from the base sha, last commit adds only `EVIDENCE-t<n>.md`, push; completion = background loop every 20 min `git fetch` + `git cat-file -e origin/t<n>-cloud:EVIDENCE-t<n>.md` (D-058 addendum allows this polling only here); receive = check last commit adds only EVIDENCE -> `git branch t<n> origin/t<n>-cloud~1` -> `ticket.py set <n> base_sha` to `git merge-base main t<n>` -> `--prepare worker` (reuses the existing branch) -> `git show origin/t<n>-cloud:EVIDENCE-t<n>.md > <round dir>/EVIDENCE-round1.md` -> same apply/gate/land; routine token cost is unknown).
  - docs/DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md §1: the dispatcher is `auto-fix.sh` either way (headless, or `--prepare` + in-session subagent); one sentence that the rc 8 overreach guard only wraps auto-fix-started processes, the in-session rules are the same.
  - scripts/auto-fix.sh header: `--prepare` usage and a pointer to SESSION-START.
Not kept from the old ticket: `--cloud-prompt`, `--cloud-wait`, `apply.sh --cloud`, `cloud:` cost rows (all deleted; the routine fallback lives in the reference as manual steps). role-models.json unchanged.
D-053 ④: improves VISION "每張落地票的 token 與時間" (one command per dispatch for main, subagent reads its packet once, no 20-min wake-ups) and "每張票需要我介入幾次" (no hand-built round state to drift). Adds no gate; removes the planned cloud-receive shape check.
Depends: #146 landed 239f4d3 (needs_verifier missing = true is already the rule `verifier_wanted` applies); no open dependency.
acceptance: Prepare worker (worker writes; tests/test_auto_fix.py next to TheFirstRoundPacket, same AutoFixBase sandbox, WORKER_NEVER stub): Ready ticket whose base_sha lags main by one commit -> `--prepare worker` rc 0; afterwards: ticket state Running and base_sha == `git rev-parse main`; `<home>/repo-wt/t1` exists with HEAD on t1 == main head; `<home>/repo-wt/fix-t1/round1` exists; exactly one `reports/t1/*/dispatch-round1.md` exists, starts with `# 規則包：worker` and contains the ticket subject; stdout contains `model=opus`, that dispatch file's absolute path, `#1`, the full main sha, the worktree path and `<home>/repo-wt/fix-t1/round1/EVIDENCE-round1.md`; stdout does NOT contain `# 規則包` nor a ```json fence; `self.worker_rounds() == []`; events file has no new `ticket.attempt.*` / `agent.*` line; ticket cost[] unchanged.

Prepare refusals (worker writes, same module): ticket state InReview -> `--prepare worker` rc 2, ticket file bytes identical, no `repo-wt/t1`, no round dir; `--prepare worker --dry-run` -> rc 2; `--prepare verifier` on a ticket with needs_verifier false -> rc 2 and no `verify-t1` dir; `--prepare verifier` with interface_fixed not true and branch t1 absent or with no commit beyond base_sha -> rc 2, stderr names waiting for the worker, no `verify-t1` dir. Worker chain whose first candidate is a codex tool and ticket model empty -> stdout `model=` names the first claude-code candidate.

Hand-off end to end (verifier writes; existing tests/test_auto_fix.py or tests/test_apply.py, no new ticket-numbered file, D-056 ①): `--prepare worker` -> the test plays the subagent (one commit adding a file in the printed worktree; writes an EVIDENCE with the four sections and a ```result``` block at the printed EVIDENCE path) -> `sh scripts/apply.sh 1` with NO `--evidence` rc 0 -> `result-round1.json` extracted under reports/t1/, ticket branch == t1. Then `--prepare verifier` rc 0 -> `<home>/repo-wt/verify-t1/round1/base` holds the file the fake worker committed (copy came from t1 head, not base_sha); test writes a case file in work/, `diff -ruN base work > patch-verify.diff`, EVIDENCE-verifier.md with a result block -> `apply.sh 1 <copy>/patch-verify.diff --evidence-verifier <copy>/EVIDENCE-verifier.md` rc 0 -> t1 head is one commit past the worker's commit and that commit adds the case file. With interface_fixed true and no worker commit, `--prepare verifier` rc 0 and base/ equals the base_sha tree.

Unchanged oracles: TheFirstRoundPacket, TheFirstRoundStartsFromReady and the #57 base-follow tests in tests/test_auto_fix.py stay green with their assertions untouched (`--dry-run --round 1` output and `auto-fix.sh <n>` round 1 behaviour do not change); `git diff main -- board/role-models.json scripts/apply.sh scripts/gate.sh scripts/land.sh scripts/review.sh` is empty; no `--cloud-prompt` / `--cloud-wait` / `--cloud` string in scripts/ or tests/ (grep 0).

`sh scripts/gate.sh --branch --ticket 149` green. Docs (read by the reviewer against this ticket, not string-tested): SESSION-START main section has the dispatch order of objective (4) including `--no-auto-fix` on gate/land and "call the same subagent back"; the reference has the routine fallback steps; DISPATCH-TEMPLATE §1 names both dispatch forms.
test_plan:
Expected values come from D-061 and its #151 evidence, the existing conventions this ticket names (round dir path apply.sh:583, worktree `<worktree_dir>/t<n>`, `--dry-run --round 1` packet), and the flag/path/stdout fields pinned in objective (1)-(3); never from the program under test.
Environment: the cloud container runs as uid 0 (#151). No test may rely on permission denial (chmod/0o555 tricks are no-ops as root) or on signalling processes; board/config.json hard_block rejects new lines in tests/** verify/** containing os\.kill, killpg, pkill or `kill -`. Use the existing Sandbox (tests/control_harness.py), the WORKER_NEVER stub, `worker_rounds()` and the tripwire (`assert_no_tripwire`) to prove no agent started; no model, no network, no routine API.
Worker: implement (1)-(4); acceptance 1-2 in tests/test_auto_fix.py. Only tests to run (foreground, `timeout 590`): `python3 -m unittest tests.test_auto_fix` and `python3 -m unittest tests.test_apply`, then `sh scripts/gate.sh --branch --ticket 149`. Not the full suite.
Verifier (needs_verifier=true, interface_fixed=true: flag names, paths, stdout fields and ticket effects are pinned here, so it starts in parallel): acceptance 3 into an existing module (tests/test_auto_fix.py or tests/test_apply.py; D-056 ① no ticket-numbered file); real auto-fix.sh / apply.sh subprocesses in the Sandbox; the test itself plays the subagent.
Mutations (not run, opener could not without an implementation): M1 drop the early stop so --prepare starts the worker -> acceptance 1 `worker_rounds() == []` red; M2 skip Ready->Running -> acceptance 1 state red; M3 put the round dir under reports/ -> acceptance 3 `apply.sh 1` without --evidence red; M4 cat the packet to stdout -> acceptance 1 `# 規則包` absence red; M5 let --prepare verifier copy from base_sha when interface_fixed is false and no worker commit -> acceptance 2 red; M6 emit ticket.attempt.start -> acceptance 1 events red.
Oracles checked: tests/test_auto_fix.py TheFirstRoundPacket (:1108, asserts the dry-run packet shape; must stay as is), TheFirstRoundStartsFromReady (:1149); the only `不認得` assertion there is `--round 只接 1` (:1141), so extending the unknown-flag message is safe; tests/test_apply.py classes use their own ApplyBase and do not exercise auto-fix.
outline:
Summary: D-061 makes in-session subagents the primary dispatch (cloud and Mac). Script only one entry, `auto-fix.sh <n> --prepare worker|verifier`: it runs auto-fix's existing round-1 prefix (base bump, worktree, round dir at the path apply.sh already defaults to, rules-pack packet file, verifier copy, Ready->Running) and stops before starting a process, printing a ~10-line pointer prompt. Everything else is docs: SESSION-START main order prepare -> subagent -> apply -> gate --no-auto-fix -> land --no-auto-fix, redo = call the same subagent back; routine kept as a manual fallback in the reference. Old --cloud-prompt / --cloud-wait / --cloud and cloud: cost rows dropped.
Order: worker prepare -> verifier prepare -> docs.
Files that move (grepped): scripts/auto-fix.sh (header :1-12, usage :95, flag parse :119-140, first_round_dispatch :976, round-1 start :1040-1075, round_once :2415-2500, verifier copy :1755-1790); tests/test_auto_fix.py; docs/SESSION-START.md main; docs/reference/role-procedures.md main; docs/DISPATCH-TEMPLATE.md §1. Not touched: apply/gate/land/review, role-models.
needs_verifier=true: new hand-off path into apply; the e2e case is a different layer than the worker's unit cases. interface_fixed=true. complex: refactors auto-fix's shared round-1 prefix.
For main to decide (with suggestion): 1. In-session subagent tokens only reach agent.cost events, not ticket cost[] (VISION line 51) -> suggest a separate ticket. 2. No overreach guard in-session -> accept for now. 3. Reviewer still headless via review.sh -> separate ticket if it fails in the cloud.
